transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. Could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

My job says everything is fine, but I know certain people at work are secretly working against me and I can’t be convinced otherwise. They are trying to sabotage my reputation, and no amount of reassurance from management is going to change what I know is happening.
Besides these concerns about your coworkers, have you been experiencing any significant periods of feeling extremely depressed or unusually high-spirited and energetic?
No, I haven't had any extreme highs or lows like that. My mood has been pretty stable, and my only real concern is what's been going on with my coworkers at the office.
Besides your concerns about your coworkers, have you ever experienced hearing voices or seeing things that others around you do not seem to perceive?

No, I have never experienced anything like that at all. I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there. My mind is completely clear, and my only concern is the actual physical tampering happening with my work.
How long have you felt that your coworkers were working against you, and have you noticed any other changes in your daily life or habits since this started?

This all started about fourteen months ago when our IT department began restructuring. Since then, I've been spending extra hours documenting every little thing and staying up late planning to protect myself, which has slowed my work down a bit and caused some tension with the team. Other than that, I still handle my usual mentoring and newsletter writing without any issues.

Aside from the tension regarding your coworkers, have you noticed any decline in your ability to perform your regular daily tasks, such as maintaining personal hygiene or managing your household responsibilities?

No, not at all. Outside of the stress and the extra hours I spend documenting everything at work, my daily life is completely unaffected. I have absolutely no issues taking care of myself, keeping up with chores around the house, or managing any of my other routine responsibilities.
